text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 07 · 海岛白石泳池庭院.
Environment:  A secluded Greek island villa courtyard in morning light. Cream travertine colonnade and flat-roofed modern pavilion, a narrow still pale-aqua swimming pool offset left, two linen-covered lounge chairs to far right, ceramic water jug on a small oak table. Open colonnade frames a hazy pale blue sea beyond cypress foliage. Center terrace clear, eye-level layered architectural view, restrained Greek proportions without famous replica or glass onion dome, realistic small water ripples, no swimmers or boats with people.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 07 · 海岛白石泳池庭院. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
